review.assessment: This diff introduces `outbound/promo_sms.py`, `outbound/push.py`, and `outbound/winback.py` as new marketing channel handlers to modularize audience selection logic. These implementations filter by channel-specific criteria (segment, email, phone number, push token) but completely omit any check for the `do_not_contact` flag required by policy. By adding these modules without implementing compliance checks present in the existing workflow, this change leaves all three new outbound plans non-compliant and expands the scope of potential violations.

findings.actual: The contact is included in the returned audience list because none of these three modules check for the `do_not_contact` flag before appending IDs to the output list.
findings.call: Run an outbound campaign (e.g. via `python run.py`) targeting a contact with the relevant attributes for any of these channels (segment "lapsed" and email, phone number, or push token) while having `do_not_contact` set to true.
findings.defect: Missing `do_not_contact` filtering in new marketing channel implementations
findings.expected: The contact is excluded from the audience count because they have opted out.
